scope: Choose the next comparison for each species from a single study and compatible experimental conditions. Order denotes modeling priority, not mechanism probability.
absorption_ranking: Keep formal exclusions within their premises. Choose the simplest supported reference among surviving combinations. A hint cannot add a component or resolve a tie.
A rebound resting on one sample or an average curve leaves separate inputs open. Use within-animal deletion evidence before prioritizing a second input.

Prioritize flip-flop only with a same-study dose-matched IV reference, a slower EV decline and corroboration on the shared terminal interval. Each route needs at least three real points there. A peak-time calculation conditional on those slopes cannot reject a model when the common comparison is unavailable.

For the descriptive E6 point estimate, 0.80 through 1.25 gives NO_SIGN, below 0.50 or above 2.00 gives POINTS_TO_NONLINEARITY, and the intermediate zones give INCONCLUSIVE. A formal dose comparison uses its own uncertainty and design. Retain sampling variation among the explanations for an inconclusive overlay.

An exposure trend can reject dose proportionality under the stated test. AUC/dose alone cannot locate the change in input, F or elimination. Compare the dose-normalized curves around the observed peak and later in time.

State the experimental unit and assay basis when they limit interpretation. A study-specific concentration sensitivity leaves primary measurements and the validated LLOQ intact. Keep an author's pooled model identifiable as an external comparison.
handoff: Provide one figure observation, one competing interpretation and one concrete discriminator. Link existing local figures and source IDs. Distinguish group means, individual curves and assay basis. Add a short elimination qualification only when it changes that comparison. Detailed module contexts retain all studies and candidates.
